payload.rationale: This document is a later sprint retro (2026-09-24) echoing the prior Sprint 4 Retro (2026-03-22) — same three claims: async decision widget shipped, 23-point velocity, Zephyr as key unlock. I expanded the prior retro document and all its directly matching positions/observations (ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Obs_TinaVelocity, Sprint4ThesisProven, ZephyrRateLimitResolved) so the passes can link, extend, or note divergence. I also expanded the three core narratives (AntiSlackPositioning, DecisionsEvaporate, DecisionCaptureAtConsensus) and their child positions (CoreFeatureDecisionCapture, AntiPatternRealtimeChat, ContextPreservationNextSprint, WebhookArchitecture) because the widget shipping is the product thesis in action and the passes need the narrative frame to place it. Pricing, category, and target-market positions were included as already-surfaced children of the AntiSlack narrative — they give the passes the full product context without additional expansion cost. No further expansion was needed; the document is short and every overlapping area is covered.
